policies.outbound:
<set-variable name="requestBody" value="@(context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />
                <set-variable name="isToolsRequest" value="@{
                    try {
                        string body = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestBody");
                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(body)) {
                            return false;
                        }
                        
                        JObject request = JObject.Parse(body);
                        string method = request["method"]?.ToString();
                        
                        return method == "tools/list" || method == "tools/call";
                    } catch {
                        return false;
                    }
                }" />
                
                
                    <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isToolsRequest"))">
                        <set-variable name="requestMethod" value="@{
                            string body = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestBody");
                            JObject request = JObject.Parse(body);
                            return request["method"]?.ToString();
                        }" />
                        
                        
                        
                            <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestMethod") == "tools/call")">
                                <set-variable name="requestedTool" value="@{
                                    string body = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestBody");
                                    JObject request = JObject.Parse(body);
                                    return request["params"]?["name"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                }" />
                                
                                <set-variable name="isToolAllowed" value="@{
                                    string requestedTool = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestedTool");
                                    JArray allowedTools = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("allowedTools");
                                    
                                    foreach (var tool in allowedTools) {
                                        if (tool.ToString() == requestedTool) {
                                            return true;
                                        }
                                    }
                                    return false;
                                }" />
                                
                                
                                
                                    <when condition="@(!context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isToolAllowed"))">
                                        
                                            
                                            
                                                application/json
                                            
                                            @{
                                                string requestedTool = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestedTool");
                                                JArray userRoles = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("userRoles");
                                                
                                                JObject error = new JObject();
                                                error["jsonrpc"] = "2.0";
                                                error["id"] = null;
                                                error["error"] = new JObject();
                                                error["error"]["code"] = -32001;
                                                error["error"]["message"] = $"Access denied: Tool '{requestedTool}' is not available for your role(s): {userRoles.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None)}";
                                                
                                                return error.ToString();
                                            }
                                        
                                    
                                
                            
                            
                            <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestMethod") == "tools/list" && context.Response.StatusCode == 200)">
                                <set-variable name="originalResponse" value="@(context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />
                                @{
                                    try {
                                        string responseBody = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("originalResponse");
                                        JArray allowedTools = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("allowedTools");
                                        
                                        // Parse the response
                                        JObject response = JObject.Parse(responseBody);
                                        
                                        // Check if it's a successful tools/list response
                                        if (response["result"] != null && response["result"]["tools"] != null) {
                                            JArray allTools = (JArray)response["result"]["tools"];
                                            JArray filteredTools = new JArray();
                                            
                                            // Filter tools based on allowed list
                                            foreach (var tool in allTools) {
                                                string toolName = tool["name"]?.ToString();
                                                bool isAllowed = false;
                                                
                                                foreach (var allowedTool in allowedTools) {
                                                    if (allowedTool.ToString() == toolName) {
                                                        isAllowed = true;
                                                        break;
                                                    }
                                                }
                                                
                                                if (isAllowed) {
                                                    filteredTools.Add(tool);
                                                }
                                            }
                                            
                                            // Replace tools array with filtered version
                                            response["result"]["tools"] = filteredTools;
                                        }
                                        
                                        return response.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
                                    } catch (Exception ex) {
                                        // If filtering fails, return original response
                                        return context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("originalResponse");
                                    }
                                }
